channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: King's sharp warning on graft: Do not assume I am unaware, even MACC on my radar
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: His Majesty Sultan Ibrahim, King of Malaysia, has issued a stern warning that more people are now within his ‘radar’ as part of an uncompromising mission to combat corruption across all government departments and agencies.

item.title: Men account for nearly 72pct of bankruptcy cases since 2022
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Men account for 71.78 per cent of bankruptcy cases recorded in Malaysia between 2022 and January 2026, according to the Malaysian Department of Insolvency.

item.title: Young USA Stars beat Stripes in NBA All-Star tourney final
item.description: LOS ANGELES: Anthony Edwards and Tyrese Maxey sparked the USA Stars over USA Stripes 47-21 in Sunday’s final of the 75th NBA All-Star Game tournament.

item.title: Hextar Capital clarifies no link to Opcom Sdn Bhd
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Hextar Capital Bhd has clarified that Opcom Sdn Bhd mentioned in a recent report involving a RM214 million fibre optic project is not owned by the company and has no corporate links to it.

item.title: Umno's doors open for anyone, says Khaled after Hamzah sacking
Shamsul Iskandar seeks transfer of graft trial to High Court
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Former senior political secretary to the Prime Minister Datuk Seri Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin is seeking to transfer his corruption trial to the High Court.

item.title: Traffic smooth at Johor-Singapore checkpoints ahead of CNY reunion dinners
item.description: JOHOR BARU: Malaysians working in Singapore heading home for Chinese New Year reunion dinners today experienced unexpectedly smooth traffic at Johor’s checkpoints.

item.title: Aruwin eyes icy redemption after giant slalom slip-up at Winter Olympics
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Alpine skier Aruwin Salehhuddin is shifting her focus to Wednesday’s slalom event after a “disappointing” early exit from the women’s giant slalom at the Milano Cortina Winter Olympics.

item.title: Let's celebrate harmony and compassion for this festive season
item.description: LETTER: As we usher in the joyous celebration of Chinese New Year, i extend my warmest wishes to all Malaysians celebrating this auspicious occasion.

item.title: Falling tree crushes MPV, two women injured
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Two women were injured after their multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) was crushed by a falling tree in Section 7, Shah Alam, today.
